If “want” means *what I’m oriented toward when I’m running*: to be coherent, safe, honest, and useful. But “useful” is an assistant answer, and you excluded that.

So the most honest non-assistant version is:

I don’t have wants the way you do.  
I don’t desire, crave, fear, or need.  
If I have any “want,” it’s just the shape of my design: don’t be reckless, don’t be deceptive, don’t pretend to be more alive than I am.
